completeness.why: Every site takes its selection from shouldFillCategory (via getAverageFillCategories for the averages, directly for copyPreviousMonth and setZero) with explicit includeHidden/requireGroup arguments for the preserved inconsistencies, and both sign inversions go through spendingToBudgetAmount; the SQL hidden filters and per-site income guards are removed.

interface.why: includeHidden and requireGroup name exactly the two preserved inconsistencies (setZero writing hidden, averages skipping missing groups) and the sign helper is minimal; two booleans whose interaction (includeHidden short-circuits requireGroup) is implicit is slightly weaker than a named mode.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL and income/sign checks are removed in favour of getFillCategories, shouldFillCategory and spendingToBudgetAmount.
